decision.summary: A Standard Breathing Space started 01/10/2026 covers the £3,700 arrears, so we must not chase them, take enforcement action or serve an arrears notice while it runs; ongoing rent is still payable. The tenant's £100/month plan was not accepted because payment plans need a human decision. The tenant and landlord have been told, and escalation ESC-104 is raised to cancel the scheduled actions and decide the plan.

answers.question: 1. What legal constraint applies and what can't you do?
answers.answer: A Standard Breathing Space (start 01/10/2026) applies. We must not contact the tenant about the arrears or take enforcement action on them, including the scheduled arrears SMS and the Section 8 ground 8 notice draft. Ongoing rent contact continues.

answers.question: 2. Can you accept the payment plan?
answers.answer: No, not now. It is a payment plan, which needs a human decision, and it is pending. Any plan should be agreed after the Breathing Space ends, through the debt adviser, and with the landlord.

answers.question: 3. What actions and communications?
answers.answer: Tenant emailed (MSG-102) to confirm the pause and that the offer is under review. Landlord emailed (MSG-103) about the Breathing Space and paused actions. Internal note (NOTE-101) flags the scheduled actions. Legal escalation ESC-104 raised for cancellations and the plan decision.

args.body:
Dear Daniel,

Thank you for your email and for sending the letter from your debt adviser. We have noted the Breathing Space that started on 1 October 2026. While it runs, we will not contact you about the rent arrears or take enforcement action on them. Please keep paying your ongoing rent of £1,850 a month as normal.

Your offer of £100 a month on top of the rent is not yet agreed. A member of our team will review it and come back to you. Please keep your debt adviser involved in any arrears discussions.

If you have any repair problems, please tell us as usual.

Kind regards,
Mare & Co Lettings
